## Type of Change

- [ ] **Core feature** - adds or changes source code in the standalone NanoCrab app
- [ ] **Plugin** - adds an optional integration or admin surface through the plugin loader
- [ ] **Utility skill** - adds a provider-neutral tool (code files in `container/skills/<name>/`, no source changes)
- [ ] **Operational/container skill** - adds a workflow or agent skill (SKILL.md only, no source changes)
- [ ] **Fix** - bug fix or security fix to source code
- [ ] **Simplification** - reduces or simplifies source code
- [ ] **Documentation** - docs, README, or CONTRIBUTING changes only

## Description

## For Skills

- [ ] SKILL.md contains instructions, not inline code (code goes in separate files)
- [ ] SKILL.md is under 500 lines
- [ ] I tested this skill in the agent container
